$Comment: How a Droplist reward READS where a screen shows it before it pays out. A droplist names a
drop table whose contents SPILL into the world when the reward is granted, so no specific
item can be promised ahead of time; every one reads as the same generic drop instead.
This file is presentation only: it names no Command, so the built-in Droplist handler keeps
the payout, and nothing here changes what drops.
NameKey - one label for every droplist reward ('Loot Drop'), shipped by this library in
Icon    - a crate, the shape a player already reads as goods spilling on the ground.
A reward may still write its own NameKey or Icon to read as something more specific. To
